text: sed -n 285,330p src/codegen_support/runtime/io/fopen.rs: am_open is slot 0, so its mask bit is bit 0 emitter.instruction("str x13, [sp, #56]"); // save the flag across the handle-slot scan and the call emitter.instruction("ldr x11, [x10]"); // load the stream_open method pointer from slot 0 emitter.instruction("cbz x11, __rt_fopen_uw_fail"); // class did not implement stream_open → silent fail emitter.instruction("str x11, [sp, #48]"); // save stream_open ptr across the upcoming blr // -- reserve a stream-handle slot, growing the table on demand -- // PHP places no limit on simultaneously open wrapper streams, so the only // failure left is heap exhaustion, reported as -1. emitter.instruction("bl __rt_user_wrapper_handles_reserve"); // x0 = free handle slot (-1 on heap exhaustion) emitter.instruction("cmp x0, #0"); // did the reservation fail? emitter.instruction("b.lt __rt_fopen_uw_fail"); // silent fail (obj is freed on the shared fail path)
